title: WELCOME TO LUMEN HOTEL: STAFF ONBOARDING
nextLesson: YOUR FIRST DAY AT THE FRONT DESK

questions.q: What time does the morning shift start?
questions.good: Correct! We resume at eight o'clock sharp.
questions.hint: Think about the shift times in the working-day scene.
questions.review: The morning shift starts at eight o'clock. Arrive fifteen minutes early.

questions.q: How many rooms does Lumen Hotel have?
questions.good: Right! We have one hundred and twenty rooms on five floors.
questions.hint: Remember the number from the about-our-hotel scene.
questions.review: The hotel has five floors and one hundred and twenty rooms.

questions.q: At what time does guest check-in start?
questions.good: Correct! Check-in is at three in the afternoon, and check-out is at eleven in the morning.
questions.hint: It is the time guests arrive in the afternoon.
questions.review: Check-in starts at three in the afternoon. Check-out is at eleven in the morning

questions.q: Who leads the front desk reception team?
questions.good: Yes! Mr. Kola is our Front Desk Supervisor.
questions.hint: He wears a supervisor badge and a gold tie.
questions.review: Mr. Kola is the Front Desk Supervisor and leads Abel, Nelson, Tunde, and Aishat.

questions.q: How long is your meal break?
questions.good: Correct! One forty-five-minute meal break, plus two fifteen-minute rest breaks.
questions.hint: It is longer than the short rest breaks.
questions.review: Each shift has one forty-five-minute meal break and two fifteen-minute rest brea

o: Your clean uniform and your name tag
questions.q: What must you wear at all times during your shift?
questions.good: Right! Guests judge our hotel by how we look.
questions.review: Always wear a clean, pressed uniform and your name tag.

questions.q: A guest walks in. How soon should you greet them with a smile?
questions.good: Correct! Greet guests within ten seconds.
questions.hint: It is a very short time.
questions.review: Smile and greet every guest within ten seconds.

questions.q: What is the first step when a guest is unhappy?
questions.good: Yes! Listen first, then apologize, solve, and thank.
questions.hint: It is the first word you heard in that scene.
questions.review: Listen, apologize, solve the problem, and thank the guest.

o: Give the number to a friend
Do not say it, and offer to connect the call instead
questions.q: A caller asks for a guest's room number. What do you do?
questions.hint: Remember the safety and privacy scene.
questions.review: Never give out a room number. Offer to connect the call.

o: Report it to security straight away
questions.q: What should you do if you see something unusual?
questions.good: Right! Report anything unusual to security at once.
questions.hint: Think about who keeps the hotel safe.
questions.review: Report anything unusual to security straight away.

announcements.text: On your first morning, arrive at 7:45 AM. Collect your uniform and name tag from Human Resources.
Write down the name and role of every person you meet today.
